inj.note: Hamilton suffered a ruptured quad during Sunday's game versus the Colts, and now he'll spend the rest of the season on IR. His departure from Jacksonville's defensive line figures to open up more opportunities for 2024 second-rounder Ruke Orhorhoro as the campaign continues.
inj.label: Out for season

news.h: Jaguars DT DaVon Hamilton (quad), S Eric Murray (elbow) out for season
news.d: Jaguars nose tackle DaVon Hamilton and safety Eric Murray both suffered season-ending injuries during Sunday's win over the Colts, coach Liam Coen announced Monday.
